// HANDS.md hand 1: one Island and six Opt, which is the canonical budget hand.
//
// Seven cards, so the opening hand is the whole library and every path is this
// deal — a probability here is a yes or a no, which is what makes the number
// checkable by hand. Turn 1 plays the Island, taps it and casts one Opt. The
// other five are dead, and a model that fires an effect whenever the card is
// in hand reports six.
1x Island [Land]
6x Opt [Cantrip]
